name: vtable
meaning: 0x574304, a single slot: the scalar deleting destructor 0x406D80.

name: initialized
meaning: Set to 1 once SoundDevice_Init has created the primary buffer.

name: pDS
meaning: The IDirectSound object, handed to the sound layer by SoundDevice_GetDSound.

name: pPrimaryBuffer
meaning: Primary (mixer) buffer; SetFormat is applied to it and it is left playing looped for the whole session.

name: hasHwStreamingMixer
meaning: DSCAPS.dwMaxHwMixingStreamingBuffers != 0. Decides whether secondary buffers are created LOCDEFER or STATIC.

name: devices
meaning: Enumerated DirectSound devices (SoundDeviceEntry, 0x38 each: char description[0x28] then GUID guid at +0x28). A NULL GUID means the default device.

name: deviceCount
meaning: Number of enumerated DirectSound devices (capped at 20 by DS_EnumCallback).

name: streamOwners
meaning: Owner object of each of the 16 stream notification slots; NULL means free. Only StreamSound registers (stream_sound.cpp), and the device calls StreamSound methods on them.

name: streamEvents
meaning: (HANDLE[16]; typed void *[16] by run3/snd_device so the source can index it: CreateEventA result stored at 0x4066a5) 16 manual CreateEventA handles that DirectSound position notifications signal; Main_Loop waits on all of them every frame with a zero timeout.

name: streamCount
meaning: Number of registered streams. Incremented on register, decremented on unregister; SoundDevice_GetVoiceAmplitude 0x406a8f (and its unused twin 0x406ade) index streamOwners with it.
